instruction: Open the flight status page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated from United Airlines homepage to the baggage fee calculator in 5 turns. Path: homepage → 'Changed bag rules' link → checked bags page → 'Calculate bag fees' button → fee calculator page.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate United Airlines website, find and click navigation links, locate specific tools/pages from homepage through intermediate pages.
metadata.task_rationale: Flight status is a prominent navigation target visible in the top tab bar. Similar navigation difficulty to the original task but targets a different section of the site.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the flight status page from United Airlines homepage. Evaluator uses URL pattern matching to verify the agent reached a flight-status URL on united.com. The 'Flight status' tab is visible in the top navigation bar.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_tab_info' correctly extracts active tab URL and returns a dict with 'url' field, which the metric handles properly.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict directly (via get_rule) and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex patterns.
URL pattern 'united\.com.*(flightstatus|flight-status|flight.status)' is semantically appropriate and covers common URL variations for United Airlines flight status page.
Single-step instruction (open flight status page) is fully covered by the single URL pattern check — complete verification coverage.

Minor concern: get_active_tab_info reloads the page via Playwright navigation, which could cause redirects on dynamic sites like United Airlines. However, the URL pattern is flexible enough to handle typical variations.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using 'get_active_url_from_accessTree' getter directly instead of 'active_tab_info' to avoid page reload side effects on the dynamic United Airlines site.
